subject: METHOD-ID paragraph
notes: cite.py --check 11.7.3 "The method in the superclass shall not be defined with the FINAL clause." -> OK §11.7.3 3). First sentence: OVERRIDE with no superclass method of that name -> COBOL0838 (incl. no INHERITS). The resolution signature is the name alone (parametric polymorphism not claimed, CONFORMANCE.md A.4.10 item 3); a same-name base with a different parameter list is then rejected by the §11.7.3 SR9 / §9.3.8.2.3 override conformance (OoConformance) — rejected either way. Second sentence: base FINAL -> COBOL0839, including an indirect FINAL ancestor (probe p6, 2002/2023). An OVERRIDE whose only same-named method is an IMPLEMENTED interface prototype (not a superclass method) is correctly 0838 because the lookup is superclass-only.
